subject: Re: PO assignment and line-item mapping for SkyLine onboarding
messages:
From: Marta Diaz <marta@skylinematerials.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: PO# mismatch on onboarding — need correct PO for invoicing

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for walking through the onboarding steps earlier. We completed the vendor intake form and uploaded the initial SKU list, but our finance team is blocked: the items in the intake were split across two internal purchase references and we only received a provisional token (P-????) instead of a final PO number. We can’t submit invoices without a stable PO# and the current spend cap is preventing us from accepting a partial ship.

Quick summary:
- Account: SkyLine Materials
- Onboarding form submitted: SK-2026-07-31 (attached)
- Current preview token: provisional-token-61
- Problem: two line items were duplicated and assigned to two different PO tokens; spend cap shows $10,000 (too low for first shipment)

Can procurement issue a proper PO or a provisional with a temporary spend increase so we can invoice for the initial shipment? We’d prefer a single PO that maps the two SKU lines under one reference and notes the quantity split.

Attached: SKY-setup-form.pdf (filled intake)

Marta Diaz
Procurement Lead, SkyLine Materials
marta@skylinematerials.com
+1 415-555-0192
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marta Diaz <marta@skylinematerials.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO# mismatch on onboarding — need correct PO for invoicing

Hi Marta — thanks for the note and for attaching the intake. We see the duplication on our side (two SKU rows with slightly different descriptors were created during intake).

Immediate plan:
1) Procurement (cc’d) will draft a provisional PO that consolidates the duplicated SKUs under one reference and includes a mapping CSV for invoicing.
2) Finance needs to approve a temporary spend cap increase to cover the first shipment — Priyom, can you advise on the quickest path for a +$60k provisional bump?
3) Once we have the provisional PO number we’ll send the final PDF for SkyLine’s accounting to match to invoices.

Monica — I’m pasting the key line items from Marta’s intake in a follow-up; please confirm the mapping and share the provisional PO draft by EOD tomorrow.

Marta — I’ll keep you updated; feel free to copy acct@skylinematerials.com on any finance confirmations.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Manager, Procurement Onboarding
Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Draft provisional PO + proposed line-item reconciliation for SkyLine (HS-4321)

Hi team — reviewed Marta’s intake and confirmed the duplication:
- SKU A: SKY-ALPHA-100 (qty 500) appears twice, once as a raw material line and once as a kit component.
- SKU B: SKY-BETA-200 (qty 120) assigned correct but flagged to a separate provisional token.

Proposed remediation:
- Issue provisional PO P-2026-8721 that consolidates SKU A into a single line with a note referencing the kit breakdown in the invoice mapping column.
- Keep SKU B as its own line under the same PO.
- Set provisional spend cap to $75,000 to cover initial shipment + partial ramp.

Attached is a draft CSV (provisional_po_draft.csv) with the new line mapping and a column for invoice description that SkyLine’s accounting can use. I’ve also uploaded a copy of the intake to our onboarding folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxyz/SkylinenOnboard

Priyom — can finance approve a temporary spend cap of $75k and confirm the accounting code to tag? If there’s a quicker path, please advise (temporary ACH hold, one-off cap release, etc.).

Kimberly — vendor verification flagged missing tax classification on the intake; if we’re issuing a provisional PO we should request an updated W-9 or tax form from SkyLine before final PO issuance.

Next steps:
- Priyom confirms spend cap lift (target: tomorrow morning).
- I finalize P-2026-8721 and send to Hannah for sign-off.
- Hannah to send final PO PDF to SkyLine and copy accounting.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Procurement Operations
monica_patel@redwood.com
From: Marta Diaz <marta@skylinematerials.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: SkyLine Materials Finance <acct@skylinematerials.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-13T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO assignment and line-item mapping for SkyLine onboarding

Hi Hannah / Monica — good morning.

Thanks for the fast turnaround. We received the provisional PO P-2026-8721 this morning and confirmed the line-item mapping is correct for invoicing. Our finance team also confirms they will accept the provisional PO for the first shipment. Attached is the signed PO PDF (PO_P-2026-8721.pdf) and a short invoice mapping file we’ll use when submitting the first invoice.

A couple of small housekeeping items:
- We’ll upload an updated W-9 to your intake folder by EOD.
- Please confirm whether the provisional spend cap will be reviewed automatically after the first invoice or requires an explicit chargeback.

Thanks again for moving this quickly — once I have final confirmation on the spend-cap mechanics I’ll route everything to our AP team.

Best,
Marta Diaz
Procurement Lead, SkyLine Materials
Attachments: PO_P-2026-8721.pdf
